newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Luxembourg CLT-UFA details shareholder structure.
newsitem.headline: Luxembourg CLT-UFA details shareholder structure.

text.p: Luxembourg-based broadcasting group CLT-UFA on Tuesday detailed its shareholder structure.
The newly-formed company is a product of the merger of Compagnie Luxembourgeoise de Telediffusion (CLT) with UFA, the television unit of German media group Bertelsmann.

It said that CLT's parent, Belgian-Luxembourg media holding firm Audiofina, and Bertelsmann both hold 50 percent in CLT-UFA Holding, which in turn has an 86.6 percent stake in CLT-UFA. In addition, Audiofina and Bertelsmann each have a 5.7 percent direct stake in CLT-UFA, the company said in a statement.
"Other shareholders" hold two percent of the company, CLT-UFA said in a statement.
